nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' = "Wrapped Ether".
Public string state variable 'symbol' = "WETH".
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' = 18.
Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf: ether credit ledger keyed by address; mutated in deposit, withdraw and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance: spending approvals; mutated in approve and transferFrom.
receive() external payable: entry point that forwards plain ether transfers to deposit().
deposit() public payable: credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with msg.value and emits Deposit.
withdraw(uint wad) public: checks balanceOf[msg.sender] >= wad, debits the balance and performs a native transfer to msg.sender.
totalSupply() public view: returns address(this).balance as the total supply of wrapped ether.
approve(address guy, uint wad) public: sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad and emits Approval.
transfer(address dst, uint wad) public: delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad) public: checks balance and allowance, debits src and credits dst, emits Transfer.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller address used as ledger key, allowance owner and native-transfer recipient.
msg.sender.transfer(wad): low-level native value call to an attacker-controlled address inside withdraw, executed after the balance debit.
balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value: unchecked uint addition from attacker-supplied msg.value (no SafeMath).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= wad: unchecked uint subtraction guarded only by a require on the balance.
balanceOf[src] -= wad: unchecked uint subtraction on an attacker-chosen source address.
balanceOf[dst] += wad: unchecked uint addition on an attacker-chosen destination address.
allowance[src][msg.sender] -= wad: unchecked uint subtraction of the spender's allowance.
Parameter wad of withdraw(uint wad): amount of ether to unwrap and send.
Parameter guy of approve(address guy, uint wad): spender receiving the allowance.
Parameter wad of approve(address guy, uint wad): allowance amount.
Parameter dst of transfer(address dst, uint wad): recipient of the transfer.
Parameter wad of transfer(address dst, uint wad): amount to transfer.
Parameter src of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): debited account.
Parameter dst of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): credited account.
Parameter wad of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): amount moved between accounts.

edges.reason: receive() unconditionally invokes deposit(), so plain ether transfers are credited through the payable deposit path.
transfer() delegates all state mutation to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
withdraw() reaches the native value call msg.sender.transfer(wad) while writing state variables, enabling a reentrant call path.
If msg.sender is a contract its fallback executes during transfer(wad) and can re-enter withdraw() before the transaction settles.
A contract recipient of the native transfer can re-enter the payable deposit()/receive() path during the withdrawal callback.
msg.sender supplies the ledger key credited by balanceOf[msg.sender] += msg.value in deposit().
msg.sender chooses which balance is debited and is the recipient of the native transfer in withdraw().
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose approval is overwritten in approve().
msg.sender is the implicit spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom().
msg.sender indexes the balance mutated by the unchecked subtraction in withdraw().
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance entry is decremented in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the destination of the native value call, letting an attacker-controlled contract re-enter the contract.
Parameter wad is the amount withdrawn and returned for transfer in withdraw().
Parameter wad is the subtrahend of balanceOf[msg.sender] -= wad, an unchecked uint operation in Solidity 0.6.12.
Parameter wad is the value forwarded in msg.sender.transfer(wad).
Parameter guy is used as the spender key when writing allowance[msg.sender][guy].
Parameter wad is the allowance value stored in approve().
Parameter dst is forwarded to transferFrom() as the credit target.
Parameter wad is forwarded to transferFrom() as the moved amount.
Parameter src is the debited account in transferFrom().
Parameter dst is the credited account in transferFrom().
Parameter wad is the amount transferred in transferFrom().
Parameter src selects whose balance is reduced by the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[src] -= wad.
Parameter dst selects whose balance is increased by balanceOf[dst] += wad.
Parameter src indexes the allowance entry allowance[src][msg.sender] that is decremented.
Parameter wad is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction of the source balance.
Parameter wad is the addend of the unchecked addition to the destination balance.
Parameter wad is the subtrahend of the unchecked allowance decrement.
balanceOf mapping is incremented in deposit() with attacker-supplied msg.value and no overflow protection.
balanceOf mapping is read and then decremented in withdraw() using the unchecked -= operation.
balanceOf is read for the require checks and mutated twice in transferFrom() without SafeMath.
allowance mapping is written in approve(), granting the spender arbitrary spending rights.
allowance mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom(), the access-control gate for spending other accounts' balances.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter wad of withdraw only exists to carry the amount into the withdraw function; it carries no independent semantics outside that core function.
Parameter guy of approve is only meaningful as the spender key written by the approve function.
Parameter wad of approve is only meaningful as the value assigned by the approve function.
Parameter dst of transfer is only meaningful as the recipient forwarded by the transfer function.
Parameter wad of transfer is only meaningful as the amount forwarded by the transfer function.
Parameter src of transferFrom is only meaningful as the debited account handled by transferFrom.
Parameter dst of transferFrom is only meaningful as the credited account handled by transferFrom.
Parameter wad of transferFrom is only meaningful as the amount handled by transferFrom.
